## Durability Watch 1.0

First release.

- Shows the condition of your equipped gear in percent, overall and for the most worn item.
- Small display in green, yellow (50% or less) and red (20% or less). Drag it anywhere, its position is remembered. `/dw lock` locks it in place.
- Mouse over the display to see every damaged item with its slot.
- Warns you once, on screen and in chat, when an item drops to the warning level (25% by default). The next warning comes after a repair.
- At a vendor that can repair, tells you what a full repair costs. It never repairs by itself.
- `/dw` shows the state and the commands. `/dw warn 30` sets the warning level (5 to 90), `/dw hide` and `/dw show` hide or show the display.

## Durability Watch 1.1

- New **warning before dungeons and raids**: when you enter one and an item is at 50% durability or less, you get one clear message on screen and in chat, with the instance and the most worn item, telling you to repair first.
- It warns only once per instance: not again after a wipe and the run back, and not after `/reload`. After a repair, the next visit warns again if your gear is worn.
- `/dw instance 40` sets your own level (5 to 90), `/dw instance off` switches the warning off, `/dw instance on` back on.
- `/dw` now also shows the instance warning setting. Your settings from 1.0 are kept.

## Durability Watch 1.2

- New **repair cost history**: every visit to a vendor who can repair while your gear is damaged is noted with the date and the price of a full repair, for each character on its own.
- It also notes how you paid: with your own gold, with guild money, or not repaired at that visit. Repairing single items with the repair hammer counts as your own gold.
- `/dw history` lists your last 20 visits, newest first, and what your repairs cost in the last 7 days, with the part the guild paid. `/dw history clear` empties the list of the character you are playing.
- The tooltip of the display now shows the repair costs of the last 7 days.
- Opening the same vendor again a few minutes later at the same price is not counted twice. Durability Watch still never repairs by itself.
- Your settings from 1.0 and 1.1 are kept.

## Durability Watch 1.3

- Durability Watch now speaks **German**. On clients in other languages it stays in English.
- Slot names come from the game itself now, so they read exactly like on your character sheet, in your client's language.
- Dates in `/dw history` follow your client's language.
- The commands stay the same in every language, for example `/dw history` or `/dw instance off`.
- Your settings and your repair cost history from 1.2 are kept.
